blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握劑量準確性測試的三種評估方法：標準雙側容許區間、最小可遞送劑量（Minimum Deliverable Dose）、劑量遞送效率（Dose Delivery Efficiency）
blocks.en: Master the three evaluation methods for dose accuracy testing: the standard two-sided tolerance interval, Minimum Deliverable Dose, and Dose Delivery Efficiency

blocks.en: Understand why the three-segment test (first/middle/last third of the volume) matters for verifying multi-dose NIS

blocks.en: Be able to choose the correct dose accuracy evaluation route according to System Designation (Table 2)

blocks.en: Understand how the choice of test equipment (balance, test liquid) affects the validity of the test results

blocks.zh: 為什麼用重力法（Gravimetric）測量劑量？
blocks.en: Why Measure Dose Gravimetrically?

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 明確要求用天平秤重（G<sub>meas</sub>），再換算成體積（V<sub>meas</sub> = G/ρ），而非直接用體積法（量筒、移液管）。原因：
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 explicitly requires weighing on a balance (G<sub>meas</sub>) and then converting to volume (V<sub>meas</sub> = G/ρ), rather than measuring volume directly (graduated cylinders, pipettes). The reasons:

blocks.zh: 精度更高：高精度天平的解析度可達 0.0001 g，遠優於體積量測工具
blocks.en: Higher accuracy: a high-precision balance can have a resolution of 0.0001 g, far better than volumetric measuring tools

blocks.zh: 可重複性更好：排除液體表面張力、溫度膨脹等干擾
blocks.en: Better repeatability: it eliminates interference such as liquid surface tension and thermal expansion

blocks.zh: 符合計量學規範：重力法可溯源至國際標準，體積法較難溯源
blocks.en: Consistent with metrological practice: gravimetric measurements can be traced to international standards, whereas volumetric measurements are harder to trace

blocks.zh: 換算關鍵：密度 ρ 必須在測試環境溫度下測定，溫度差 1°C 對水的密度影響約 0.0002 g/mL，對 1 mL 劑量會帶來 0.02% 的系統誤差。
blocks.en: Key point in the conversion: the density ρ must be determined at the test environment temperature. A 1°C temperature difference changes the density of water by about 0.0002 g/mL, which introduces a systematic error of 0.02% on a 1 mL dose.

blocks.zh: 試驗液的選擇：實際產品 vs. 代用液
blocks.en: Choosing the Test Liquid: Actual Product vs. Surrogate Liquid

blocks.zh: 標準說「原始藥品，或具有相似物理性質的液體」。在 CDMO 設計驗證中：
blocks.en: The standard says "the original medicinal product, or a liquid with similar physical properties". In CDMO design verification:

blocks.zh: 優先用原始藥品：最能代表實際使用情況（考慮黏度、表面張力）
blocks.en: Use the original drug product where possible: it best represents actual use (taking viscosity and surface tension into account)

blocks.zh: 高黏度藥品（如單抗生物製劑 ~50 cP）必須用原始產品或匹配黏度的代用液；不能用水替代
blocks.en: High-viscosity products (such as monoclonal antibody biologics at ~50 cP) must be tested with the original product or a surrogate liquid with matched viscosity; water cannot be substituted

blocks.zh: 若使用代用液，需在 Risk Management File 中論證「物理性質相似」的依據（黏度、密度、表面張力）
blocks.en: If a surrogate liquid is used, the basis for "similar physical properties" (viscosity, density, surface tension) must be justified in the Risk Management File

blocks.zh: CDMO 的充填製程驗證應使用 製程代用液（Process Simulation Liquid），而非純水，以確保劑量準確性數據反映實際產品特性
blocks.en: A CDMO's filling process validation should use a Process Simulation Liquid rather than plain water, to ensure that the dose accuracy data reflect the characteristics of the actual product

blocks.zh: 天平解析度的直覺計算
blocks.en: An Intuitive Calculation of Balance Resolution

blocks.zh: 「天平解析度 ≤ 最小劑量的 1%」這個要求的邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic behind the requirement "balance resolution ≤ 1% of the minimum dose":

blocks.zh: 如果測試最小劑量是 0.1 mL（約 0.1 g），天平最小刻度必須 ≤ 0.001 g。這保證量測誤差的貢獻不超過規格的 1%，讓結果主要反映 NIS 的實際性能，而非測量工具的限制。
blocks.en: If the minimum test dose is 0.1 mL (about 0.1 g), the smallest balance division must be ≤ 0.001 g. This ensures that the measurement error contributes no more than 1% of the specification, so that the results mainly reflect the actual performance of the NIS rather than the limits of the measuring tool.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO QC 實驗室：在執行充填量驗證時，使用的天平規格必須覆蓋最小充填量的 1% 解析度——這是常被忽略的設備確認要點。
blocks.en: For the CDMO QC laboratory: when performing fill volume verification, the balance specification used must cover a resolution of 1% of the minimum fill volume. This is an often overlooked equipment qualification point.

blocks.zh: Section 7: Dose Accuracy — 三種評估方法與統計框架
blocks.en: Section 7: Dose Accuracy: Three Evaluation Methods and the Statistical Framework

blocks.zh: 三區段測試：為什麼要測前/中/後？
blocks.en: Three-Segment Testing: Why Test the First, Middle and Last Third?

blocks.zh: 多劑量 NIS（A 和 C 類）需要在容器使用到前 1/3、中 1/3、後 1/3 時分別測試，原因：
blocks.en: Multi-dose NIS (categories A and C) need to be tested separately when the container is in its first third, middle third and last third of use, because:

blocks.zh: 容器壓力差異：活塞位置不同，驅動機械力不同，可能導致劑量偏差
blocks.en: Container pressure differences: the plunger position differs, so the driving mechanical force differs, which may cause dose deviation

blocks.zh: 液體黏度效應：高黏度藥品在低溫或高溫下黏度變化更大，後段測試尤其重要
blocks.en: Liquid viscosity effects: the viscosity of high-viscosity products changes more at low or high temperatures, so testing of the last segment is especially important

blocks.zh: 矽化均勻性：矽化層在使用過程中可能不均勻分布，影響活塞滑動阻力
blocks.en: Siliconization uniformity: the silicone layer may become unevenly distributed during use, affecting plunger sliding resistance

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 充填的意義：充填量的均勻性（Fill Volume Uniformity）在後段（容器 2/3 以上空間）尤其需要控制，否則「最後一劑」可能劑量不足。
blocks.en: What this means for CDMO filling: Fill Volume Uniformity needs particular control in the last segment (the upper two-thirds of the container space), otherwise "the last dose" may be underdosed.

blocks.zh: D1 製造商充填的劑量評估實例
blocks.en: Worked Example: Dose Evaluation for a Manufacturer-Filled D1

blocks.zh:
設定：1 mL autoinjector（D1 系統，製造商充填）
最小標示劑量（MDD）= 0.97 mL（見藥品標示）
測試 Y = 20 支，每支測 1 次（N = 1）

重力法測量：
G_meas = 1.003 g（測試液密度 ρ = 1.002 g/mL）
V_meas = 1.003 / 1.002 = 1.001 mL

統計評估（N=20 支結果）：
x̄ = 0.992 mL
s = 0.008 mL

查 Annex B：n=20, p=0.95, 單側
→ k_tar ≈ 2.208

k_act = (x̄ - L) / s
       = (0.992 - 0.970) / 0.008
       = 2.75

k_act (2.75) > k_tar (2.208) → ✅ PASS
blocks.en:
Setup: 1 mL autoinjector (D1 system, manufacturer-filled)
Minimum Declared Dose (MDD) = 0.97 mL (see drug product labeling)
Test Y = 20 units, one measurement per unit (N = 1)

Gravimetric measurement:
G_meas = 1.003 g (test liquid density ρ = 1.002 g/mL)
V_meas = 1.003 / 1.002 = 1.001 mL

Statistical evaluation (results for N=20 units):
x̄ = 0.992 mL
s = 0.008 mL

Look up Annex B: n=20, p=0.95, one-sided
→ k_tar ≈ 2.208

k_act = (x̄ - L) / s
       = (0.992 - 0.970) / 0.008
       = 2.75

k_act (2.75) > k_tar (2.208) → ✅ PASS

blocks.zh: 比喻：劑量遞送效率 vs. 最小遞送劑量
blocks.en: Analogy: Dose Delivery Efficiency vs. Minimum Deliverable Dose

blocks.zh: 最小遞送劑量（製造商充填 D1）：就像訂購一杯咖啡，規格是「至少 200 mL」，只要每杯都 ≥ 200 mL 就合格，多一點也無妨。
blocks.en: Minimum deliverable dose (manufacturer-filled D1): like ordering a cup of coffee with a specification of "at least 200 mL"; as long as every cup is ≥ 200 mL it passes, and a little extra does no harm.

blocks.zh: 劑量遞送效率（用戶充填 D1）：就像用戶自己把咖啡豆磨粉後放進機器，要求「至少打出 90% 的磨粉」——這裡評估的是「能否充分利用用戶充填的量」，而不是絕對量。
blocks.en: Dose delivery efficiency (user-filled D1): like the user grinding coffee beans and putting the grounds into the machine, with a requirement to "expel at least 90% of the grounds"; what is assessed here is "whether the amount the user filled is used effectively", not the absolute quantity.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO：製造商充填才是 CDMO 的職責範圍，因此最重要的合規指標是「充填量是否確保每瓶都能打出足夠的最小遞送劑量」。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: manufacturer filling is the CDMO's scope of responsibility, so the most important compliance indicator is "whether the fill volume ensures that every unit can deliver a sufficient minimum deliverable dose".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某客戶的 pen injector（Designation A）胰島素設定劑量範圍 2–80 units（0.02–0.8 mL）。根據 Table 2，此 D 設備的劑量準確性評估需要哪幾個子節的步驟？
blocks.en: A customer's pen injector (Designation A) has an insulin set dose range of 2–80 units (0.02–0.8 mL). Under Table 2, which subclauses' steps are needed to evaluate dose accuracy for this device?

blocks.zh: 同一客戶的 single-use autoinjector（Designation D1，製造商充填，1 mL 充填量）。若客戶規格是「最小遞送劑量 ≥ 0.95 mL」，CDMO 的充填量上限不足（over-fill）是否也需要控制？從 ISO 11608-1 的角度說明。
blocks.en: The same customer has a single-use autoinjector (Designation D1, manufacturer-filled, 1 mL fill volume). If the customer's specification is "minimum deliverable dose ≥ 0.95 mL", does the CDMO also need to control the upper limit of the fill volume (over-fill)? Explain from the perspective of ISO 11608-1.

blocks.zh: 客戶要求以純水代替原始生物製劑（40 mg/mL monoclonal antibody，黏度約 25 cP）進行 DV 測試。根據 Section 6.2，這樣做的風險是什麼？CDMO 應如何回應？
blocks.en: A customer asks to use plain water instead of the original biologic (40 mg/mL monoclonal antibody, viscosity about 25 cP) for DV testing. Under Section 6.2, what is the risk of doing so, and how should the CDMO respond?

blocks.zh: 三種評估路徑的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Choosing Among the Three Evaluation Routes

blocks.zh: System Designation 決定使用哪種評估方法：
blocks.en: System Designation determines which evaluation method is used:

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的 D1 製造商充填（最常見）：評估路徑是「最小可遞送劑量」——只有下限，沒有上限，核心問題是「能確保打出足夠的藥量嗎？」
blocks.en: For a CDMO's manufacturer-filled D1 (the most common case): the evaluation route is "minimum deliverable dose", which has only a lower limit and no upper limit, and the core question is "can we ensure that a sufficient amount of drug is delivered?"

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重力法為唯一測量方法：Vmeas = Gmeas/ρ，密度必須在實際測試溫度下測定；天平解析度 ≤ 最小劑量的 1%
blocks.en: Gravimetry is the only measurement method: Vmeas = Gmeas/ρ, the density must be determined at the actual test temperature; balance resolution ≤ 1% of the minimum dose

blocks.zh: 試驗液需匹配物理性質：高黏度生物製劑不可用純水替代；用代用液需在 RMF 中論證物理性質相似性
blocks.en: The test liquid must match the physical properties: high-viscosity biologics cannot be replaced with plain water; use of a surrogate liquid must be justified in the RMF with evidence of similar physical properties

blocks.zh: 三種劑量評估路徑：標準雙側 DA（A/B2/C/D2）、最小遞送劑量（製造商充填 B1/D1）、遞送效率（用戶充填 B1/D1）；D1 製造商充填是 CDMO 最常見路徑
blocks.en: Three dose evaluation routes: standard two-sided DA (A/B2/C/D2), minimum deliverable dose (manufacturer-filled B1/D1), and delivery efficiency (user-filled B1/D1); manufacturer-filled D1 is the most common route for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 多劑量三區段要求：前/中/後 1/3 容量分別測試，確保整個容量使用過程中劑量準確性一致；CDMO 充填均勻性直接影響此驗證
blocks.en: Three-segment requirement for multi-dose devices: test the first/middle/last third of the volume separately to ensure consistent dose accuracy throughout the use of the whole volume; the CDMO's fill uniformity directly affects this verification
